svg.text: SUBMISSION 07 · OPEN INNOVATION · ENVIRONMENT / AIR QUALITY
For the Open Innovation theme, Haze makes air quality something you can see: a city skyline sits behind the time, and
as the air-quality index rises the scene fills with dusty haze until the buildings fade, while a coloured badge gives
the exact number and a simple tip. When the air clears after rain the sky turns crisp blue and the face suggests
opening a window. Always-on keeps the skyline outline and the AQI number on true black.
368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
